hero.subtitle: Not ambient audio. Not meditation music. A protocol system for structured silence. 12 finite acoustic sessions engineered to produce specific cognitive outcomes.

distinction.title: This is not wellness audio
distinction.body: Every product in this category treats silence as a volume knob. MA-ZEN treats it as structural material — governed by mathematical phase curves, assigned duration, and acoustic intention.

them.title: Infinite loops
them.body: Sessions never end. Passive consumption with no cognitive resolution.

them.title: Decorative randomness
them.body: Events placed arbitrarily. No difference between meaningful and incidental.

them.title: Filler silence
them.body: Silence used to pad content, not to produce outcomes.

them.title: Mood-based naming
them.body: Rain, Forest, Ocean. Metaphor without mechanism.

us.title: Every session ends
us.body: Session termination is a design feature. Finitude creates structure.

us.title: Governed entropy
us.body: Mathematical phase curves (compound / sigmoid / linear) control acoustic density.

us.title: Silence as material
us.body: Silence ratio is a parameter — not absence of sound.

us.title: Protocol naming
us.body: Named for acoustic function. SEIJAKU, GAKE, AKANE. Precision over metaphor.

how_it_works.title: How governed silence works
how_it_works.body: Each protocol is a composition of three acoustic layers — FIELD, TEXTURE, and EVENT — governed by entropy phase curves that determine density over time.

steps.title: SELECT A PROTOCOL
steps.body: Choose by cognitive outcome (Focus, Decompression, Reset, Transition, Reflection) or browse by season.

steps.title: SET YOUR DURATION
steps.body: 10, 20, 30, or 45 minutes. The session ends at that point. Time is structure, not suggestion.

steps.title: ENTER THE FIELD
steps.body: Three acoustic layers activate. The FIELD layer anchors space. TEXTURE adds grain. EVENTS mark time.

steps.title: THE SESSION CLOSES
steps.body: The protocol resolves to silence. Not fade. Governed termination — the acoustic equivalent of a period at the end of a sentence.

items.q: How is this different from ambient sound apps like Calm or Brain.fm?
items.a: Three structural differences: (1) every MA-ZEN session ends — no infinite loops; (2) silence is a parameter with a value (silence ratio), not an absence; (3) acoustic events are governed by mathematical phase curves, not randomness. Calm and Brain.fm are designed for passive background consumption. MA-ZEN protocols are designed to be used actively and to terminate.

items.q: What does 'governed entropy' mean in practice?
items.a: Each protocol has an entropy phase curve — compound, sigmoid, or linear — that determines how acoustic density evolves over the session. A compound curve front-loads density then releases. A sigmoid curve builds slowly then resolves. Linear curves maintain consistent density. This is not a random generator. It is a composed acoustic architecture with a defined shape.

Headphones are strongly recommended for protocols in the FOCUS and REFLECTION outcomes. For RESET and DECOMPRESSION, open speakers are acceptable. The onboarding environment check will make a specific recommendation based on your protocol selection.

The Silence Ladder is a six-rung progressive practice system. Rung 1 starts at low silence density (more acoustic content). Rung 6 approaches pure silence with minimal events. Advancing through the ladder develops tolerance for unstructured cognitive space — the core skill MA-ZEN is designed to cultivate.

items.q: Can I use MA-ZEN while working?
items.a: Yes — FOCUS outcome protocols (SEIJAKU, MIYABI) are specifically designed for concurrent deep work. They create acoustic conditions without demanding attention. DECOMPRESSION and REFLECTION protocols are not designed for concurrent use — they require your full presence.
